zh.title: GE Aerospace 與波蘭 WZL-1 敲定 T700／CT7 引擎在地維修協議
zh.summary: 最終協議授權 WZL-1 在波蘭維修 T700／CT7 系列引擎，涵蓋波蘭軍方操作的 AH-64E、S-70i、AW149 與 AW101。
body: GE Aerospace 與波蘭 Military Aviation Works No. 1（WZL-1）於 2026 年 9 月 28 日簽署最終協議，建立 T700／CT7 系列引擎的授權維修、修理與翻修能力。
協議將支援波蘭武裝部隊操作的 AH-64E Apache、S-70i Black Hawk、AW149 與 AW101 直升機，並是 AH-64E 採購案工業在地化安排的一部分。
GE 表示，T700／CT7 系列累計交付超過 25,000 具，飛行時數超過 1.3 億小時。協議本身聚焦維修能力移轉，未公布設施啟用日期或投資金額。

en.title: GE Aerospace and Poland's WZL-1 finalize licensed T700/CT7 engine MRO agreement
en.summary: The agreement authorizes WZL-1 to service T700/CT7 engines in Poland for military fleets including the AH-64E, S-70i, AW149 and AW101.
body: GE Aerospace and Poland's Military Aviation Works No. 1 signed a final agreement on September 28, 2026 to establish licensed maintenance, repair and overhaul capability for T700/CT7-family engines in Poland.

The arrangement will support Polish Armed Forces fleets including the AH-64E Apache, S-70i Black Hawk, AW149 and AW101, and forms part of the industrial localization package connected to Poland's AH-64E acquisition.
GE says more than 25,000 T700/CT7 engines have been delivered and the family has accumulated over 130 million flight hours. The announcement did not give a service-launch date or investment value.

facts.claim: GE Aerospace and WZL-1 signed a final agreement for licensed T700/CT7 maintenance, repair and overhaul capability in Poland.
The capability will support Polish AH-64E, S-70i, AW149 and AW101 fleets.
GE reports more than 25,000 T700/CT7 engines delivered and over 130 million flight hours.
